newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Events in Gulf extremely dangerous - Russian source.
newsitem.headline: Events in Gulf extremely dangerous - Russian source.

text.p: Interfax news agency quoted a Russian foreign ministry source as saying on Tuesday that Moscow viewed the situation in the Gulf as "extremely dangerous" and warned it could move out of control after U.S. air strikes against Iraq.
The source told Interfax that Moscow was watching the events in Iraq with growing concern.

"The situation could get out of control," the source told the agency in a comment on the U.S. raid. "Developments in the Gulf region are taking an extremely dangerous turn. Now everything depends on further action by the Americans."

Unidentified Russian foreign ministry officials often give an initial reaction to quickly developing events, followed by an official statement. The next foreign ministry briefing is due at two p.m. (1000 GMT) on Tuesday.

Russia has generally taken a softer line on dealing with Baghdad than Western countries since the end of the 1991 Gulf War. On Monday it called for restraint in the conflict between Iraqi ruler Saddam Hussein and Kurdish rebels.
